The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]] maintained a '''laboratory''' that was discovered during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], three [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after Demagol's [[Death/Legends|death]]. The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] ordered the lab and its contents to be destroyed by demolition.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|The Butcher's Lab}}</ref>
